findings.claim: the field mapping is ambiguous between the state schema and the verdict schema
findings.evidence: flash memory constraints on embedded review targets are never mentioned in the design
findings.impact: without a tighter contract this could grow into a magnum opus of over-engineering
findings.counter: sonnet-length prose in the error message would only ever surface in verbose debug mode

rationale: the design is largely sound; only the field mapping ambiguity noted above needs clarification before implementation.
